text:
Leah - CSM: Heads-up, Hightide Labs' DS sandbox (project: wave-sim) just doubled traffic overnight and data scientists are seeing huge jitter when iterating in notebooks. Usage: https://app.redwood.dev/customers/hightide/usage :eyes:
Omar - SE: Can you paste the last 48h snapshot and which models/endpoints they're hitting?
Leah - CSM: Quick console dump:
```
48h peak qps: 810
baseline qps: 340
median tokens/req: 650
95th tokens/req: 1700
routes: /chat (60%), /embed (30%), /rerank-large (10%)
errors: ~2% 429s on /chat at peak, intermittent 504s during bursts
p95 latency (/chat) at peak: 1.8s, tail up to 4.2s
```
Priya - AE: Renewal in ~7mo. This reads like an expansion opportunity if we make the sandbox feel prod-like and low-friction. They're price-sensitive but will pay for predictable latency for notebooks.
Nina - Infra: 429s point to route-level concurrency/queueing. We can stand up a temporary dedicated pool or warm pool. Need expected sustained qps for the pilot, desired P95 SLO, and any VPC/KMS requirements.
Leah - CSM: They asked specifically for per-route token usage in the console for internal chargebacks. Also asked about session-level caching so repeated notebook prompts don't regen tokens.
Omar - SE: Models? If they're on the 32k context model we can recommend a quantized 32k-qa variant for interactive experiments and tweak batching to smaller per-notebook windows. I'll draft a short config snippet.
Leah - CSM: They're primarily on `redwood/gpt-4-compat-32k` plus some teams on `redwood/fast-slim-8k`.
quota-bot: trial_request created by Leah for customer=hightide, request=dedicated-trial-60d, gpus=2, burst_to=3
Priya - AE: Suggest 60-day pilot (vs 30) so they can run multiple experiment cycles. Proposed success metrics: sustained qps >= 600, P95 < 1s for /chat, <1% 429s, and evidence that notebook iteration time is reduced. If met, we'll push for a Reserved commit.
Nina - Infra: I can provision a 2-GPU trial pool tonight and add autoscale to 3 for bursts. I'll attach a monitoring dashboard and an alert for 429s > 1%. Need kickoff window and CSM to collect the security checklist (VPC, egress rules, KMS).
Omar - SE: I'll prepare a one-pager playbook for notebook workloads: recommended quantization flags, `batch.max_tokens`, `stream=true` for iterative UIs, and prefix KV caching. Will include a tiny repro notebook they can run.
Leah - CSM: Scheduling kickoff Wed 11am PT with Hightide leads. Capturing feature request: per-route token & token-cost breakdown in Console (they want CSV export).
Priya - AE: I'll update CRM with opportunity: "Hightide - high expansion intent: sandbox -> dedicated pilot (60d)" and flag renewal_touchpoint. Also note budget sensitivity; we should offer a clear unit-cost comparison for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Leah - CSM: Action items:
- Leah: Kickoff Wed 11am PT, send security checklist to Hightide
- Nina: Provision 2-GPU trial pool + autoscale to 3, attach dashboard/alerts
- Omar: Playbook + repro notebook before kickoff
- Priya: CRM update, pricing comparison + renewal tag
- All: Track pilot metrics on shared dashboard and capture qualitative DS feedback

I'll post status updates after the kickoff. :thumbsup:
